name: I-cholesterol ephezulu
sources: ILipid kunye ne-Atherosclerosis Society yaseMzantsi Afrika

what_is_it.heading: I-Cholesterol kwimiba ecacileyo
what_is_it.lede: I-cholesterol yinto enamafutha afunwa ngumzimba wakho ukuze wakhe iiseli kunye nokwenza iihomoni. Ingxaki luhlobo kunye nesixa-ininzi kakhulu yohlobo olungalunganga lwakha kwiindonga ze-artery kwaye ibangela ukuhlaselwa yintliziyo kunye nokubetha.
paragraphs: Isibindi sakho senza uninzi lwe-cholesterol yakho. Ezinye ziphuma nasekutyeni, ngakumbi iimveliso zezilwanyana. I-LDL ('embi') i-cholesterol ithwala amafutha kwiindonga ze-artery. I-cholesterol ye-HDL ('elungileyo') iyayisusa. Ibhalansi ibalulekile.

Abanye abantu baye bafumana i-cholesterol ephezulu (i-familial hypercholesterolaemia) - amanani abo aphezulu ngokuyingozi ukusuka ebuntwaneni, kungakhathaliseki ukutya. Lo ngoyena nobangela ungaphantsi kokuxilongwa kokuhlaselwa yintliziyo kwangoko. Ukuba isalamane esisondeleyo sinesifo sentliziyo phambi kwe-60, jonga.

items.headline: Cwaka
items.body: I-cholesterol ephezulu ayinazo iimpawu. Wazi kuphela kuvavanyo lwegazi.

items.headline: Owona nobangela
items.body: Ukuhlaselwa yintliziyo kunye nokubetha okuninzi. I-LDL ngoyena mngcipheko unamandla oguquguqukayo esiwaziyo.

items.headline: Ubalo lwemfuza
items.body: I-cholesterol ephezulu yosapho ichaphazela malunga ne-1 kubantu abangama-200 - abaninzi abanakuze bazi de kube sisifo sentliziyo.

items.headline: Statins ziyasebenza
items.body: Ubungqina obungamashumi eminyaka: ii-statins zinqumla ukuhlaselwa yintliziyo kunye nokubetha ngesithathu okanye ngaphezulu kubantu abasengozini.

pull_quote.text: ICholesterol asiyongxaki nje yokuphila. Abantu ababhityileyo, abasempilweni, abatya ngokusempilweni basenokuba necholesterol ephezulu eyingozi kwimizila yemfuza. Vavanya - ngakumbi ukuba nabani na kusapho lwakho waye wahlaselwa yintliziyo kwangoko.
pull_quote.source: ILipid kunye ne-Atherosclerosis Society yaseMzantsi Afrika

signs.heading: Yintoni onokuyibona
signs.lede: Kubantu abaninzi: akukho nto. I-cholesterol ephezulu yenza umonakalo wayo ngokuthula kumashumi eminyaka. Ekuphela kwendlela yokwazi luvavanyo lwegazi.

items.title: Akukho zimpawu zemihla ngemihla
items.description: ICholesterol ayikwenzi uzive kwanto. Uphawu lokuqala kubantu abaninzi sisifo sentliziyo okanye istroke kumashumi amane okanye amahlanu eminyaka.

items.title: Amanqanaba emfuzo aphezulu kakhulu
items.description: Amabala atyheli ajikeleze iinkophe okanye amaqhuma anamafutha kwimisipha (i-Achilles, knuckles) inokuba yimiqondiso ye-cholesterol yosapho. Iringi engwevu ejikeleze iris phambi kweminyaka engama-45 yenye.

items.title: Imbali yosapho isikhokelo
items.description: Abazali, abantakwabo, okanye ootatomkhulu abanesifo senhliziyo okanye imivimbo ngaphambi kwe-60 - ngakumbi ngaphambi kwe-50 - icebisa ngamandla i-cholesterol ephezulu yemfuza.

items.myth: Kuphela ngabantu abatyebe kakhulu abafumana icholesterol ephezulu.
items.fact: Abantu ababhityileyo nabo bafumana i-cholesterol ephezulu - rhoqo kwimfuzo. Ubume bomzimba ayisiphawuli esithembekileyo. Kuphela luvavanyo lwegazi.
I-cholesterol yokutya esuka kumaqanda inefuthe elincinci kwi-cholesterol yegazi kubantu abaninzi. Amafutha ahluthayo kunye namafutha e-trans abaluleke ngakumbi.
Izifundo ezinkulu azifumananga ikhonkco. I-Statins ngamanye amaxesha ibangela ukuqaqamba kwezihlunu - xelela ikliniki yakho ukuba kunjalo, zikhona ezinye iindlela.

items.myth: Ukuba ndiyajima, akuyomfuneko ukuba ndizikhathaze ngokutya.
items.fact: Ukwenza umthambo ubukhulu becala kunyusa iHDL (icholesterol elungileyo) kodwa kunempembelelo encinane kuphela kwiLDL. Ukutya, ubunzima, kunye namayeza abaluleke ngakumbi kwi-LDL.

prevention.heading: Uwathoba njani amanani akho
prevention.lede: I-cholesterol isabela kakuhle kwindibaniselwano yokutya, ubunzima, umthambo, kunye namayeza apho kuyimfuneko. Abantu abaninzi banokuhambisa amanani abo kakhulu kwiinyanga nje.

items.title: Ukutya kweMeditera
items.description: Imifuno, iimbotyi, iinkozo ezipheleleyo, amandongomane, intlanzi, ioli yeoli. Nciphisa inyama ebomvu, ibhotolo, ideri egcwele ikhrimu, ukutya okuqhotsiweyo, kunye nenyama egayiweyo.

items.title: Sika amafutha e-trans ngokupheleleyo
items.description: Ifihlwe kwizinto ezininzi ezibhakiweyo, iimajarini, kunye nezinto ezithathwayo eziqhotsiweyo. Funda iilebhile - nantoni na 'eneoyile ye-hydrogenated' iphumile.

items.title: Hambisa yonke imihla
items.description: Ukuzivocavoca kuphakamisa i-HDL (uhlobo oluhle) kwaye kunceda ubunzima. Nokuhamba ngokukhawuleza imizuzu engama-30 ngosuku kwenza umahluko onokumetwa.

items.title: Statins apho kubonisiwe
items.description: Ukuba umngcipheko wakho uphezulu, okanye une-cholesterol yosapho, i-statins lolona nyango lusebenzayo esinalo. Zisimahla kwiikliniki.

items.title: Fumana ipaneli yelipid
items.description: Uvavanyo olulula lwegazi lokuzila ukulinganisa i-cholesterol epheleleyo, i-LDL, i-HDL, kunye ne-triglycerides. Isimahla kuyo yonke ikliniki karhulumente ukusukela kwiminyaka engama-40 ubudala - okanye ngaphambili ngembali yosapho.

items.title: Zazi iinombolo zakho
items.description: Zibhale phantsi. I-LDL phantsi kwe-3.0 ngokubanzi injongo - phantsi kwe-1.8 ukuba sele unesifo senhliziyo okanye isifo seswekile. Obekujoliswe kuko zezakho — buza ikliniki yakho.

items.title: Ukuba iphakamileyo - qalisa ngokutya kunye nokunyakaza
items.description: Uninzi lwabantu lunokuyihlisa i-LDL nge-10–15% ngokutya nangokujima kuphela. Nika iinyanga ezintathu ukuya kwezintandathu phambi kokuba kuthathwe ukuba amayeza ayafuneka.

items.title: Ukuba iyeza liyacetyiswa - liqalise
items.description: I-Statins isebenza kakuhle ngokuthathwa yonke imihla, ixesha elide. Ukutsiba iidosi kurhoxisa uninzi lwenzuzo. Iziphumo ebezingalindelekanga aziqhelekanga kwaye zihlala zilawuleka.

items.title: Phinda ujonge rhoqo kwiinyanga ezili-12
items.description: Xa izinzile, iphaneli ye-lipid yonyaka ihlola inkqubela phambili kwaye ilungelelanise unyango ukuba luyimfuneko. Yiza neziphumo zangaphambili ukuze uthelekise.

get_help.heading: Uqale phi
get_help.lede: Ukhathalelo lweCholesterol lusimahla kwiikliniki zikarhulumente zaseMzantsi Afrika. Eyona nto inzima kukufumana uvavanyo lokuqala - wakuba unenombolo, indlela eya phambili icacile.

helplines.name: Fumana eyona kliniki ikufutshane nawe
helplines.description: Iklinikhi nganye ibonelela ngovavanyo lwasimahla lwe-cholesterol kunye neestatins zasimahla apho kumiselwe khona
helplines.meta: Akukho kuqeshwa · akukho ncedo lwezonyango olufunekayo

helplines.name: I-Heart and Stroke Foundation SA
helplines.description: Iikhatyhuleyitha zomngcipheko zasimahla, isikhokelo sokutya, kunye nenkxaso
